name: matlab-mcp
description: Persistent MATLAB/Simulink session for ZCode: run code and scripts through a FIFO job queue safe for concurrent agents, read/write structured workspace variables, export figures as PNG, gate scripts with checkcode linting, and stream live Simulink signal snapshots.

description_i18n.zh-CN: ZCode 的常驻 MATLAB/Simulink 会话：代码与脚本经 FIFO 作业队列执行（多 agent 并发安全）、结构化工作区变量读写、图表导出 PNG、checkcode 脚本门禁、Simulink 信号实时快照。
